name: GWA Solar

about:
GWA Solar operates from Altoona, Iowa, serving clients across the Midwest including Des Moines and Ames. The company brings over 25 years of energy project experience to its solar design and installation work, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been shared.

The firm provides turnkey solar solutions covering design, installation, monitoring, maintenance, and system optimization. Its services also include consulting for solar projects, with capabilities spanning residential, commercial, and utility-scale installations. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

GWA Solar works with utilities, solar photovoltaic equipment manufacturers, suppliers, and engineering firms throughout the Midwest. Its customer base includes organizations seeking design, installation, and ongoing maintenance of solar energy systems.

The company distinguishes itself as the only Iowa-based firm with two North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners (NABCEP) certified solar PV installers. It emphasizes long-standing relationships with utilities and equipment manufacturers as a foundation for quality-assured work.
